# TreloAggouri

> TreloAggouri, also known as Trelo Aggouri and TRELO AGGOURI!!!, is a funnny/joke website made by developer NGIOTSAS. The phrase Trelo Aggpuri comes from Greek Τρελό Αγγούρι 
(crazy cucumber). The main page is treloaggouri.vanic.cc

# Vanic.cc

The domain Vanic.cc is owned by mayper. See more details at about.vanic.cc

## About TreloAggouri

The origin of the name comes from a joke where NGIOTSAS and his friends, decided to name a chat Trelo Aggouri.
